item: file_lock enters its plain lock, not the Condition, and flushes the folder after a replace (audit A-005, A-030)
summary: A-005: the per-file gate was a dataclass built with a Condition and entered with with loc.cond: (the form R144 forbids), which the pin could not see; it now holds an explicit RLock, enters it, waits through src.utils.interrupts.wait, and the pin reads a Condition handed to a class and entered through an attribute. Measured with SIGALRM on CPython 3.13.14: 18 of 66,290 and 5 of 65,998 interrupts left the lock owned before, 0 of 65,901 and 0 of 66,074 after (probe gate_file_lock, gate_file_lock_contended). A-030: atomic_replace flushes the folder after os.replace (POSIX, only when the file is flushed); a platform or filesystem that cannot is counted by reason and said once, EIO is raised. 7 folder-flush tests, red-without. src/monitoring/diagnostics_runs.py drops its own copy of that folder flush (it ran right after atomic_replace and would have flushed twice); the sink sweep's allowance for the errno reads in file_lock.py goes from 2 to 4.
